contract.chanceQuantifier: AND (∀ positive-probability outcome) in every mode; terminal judged BEFORE horizon cut

tests.name: one CHANCE outcome wins, one does not ⇒ neither side certified
tests.scenario: C0 --a(chance 0.5/0.5)--> {MW terminal mouse win, MN --pass--> CN horizon survive}
tests.oldDefectBehavior: !mouseForcesWin() === true would have wrongly certified CAT_SURVIVAL

tests.name: every CHANCE outcome is a mouse win ⇒ mouse forced, cat not surviving
tests.scenario: C0 --a(chance)--> {MW1, MW2} both terminal mouse win

tests.name: every CHANCE outcome avoids mouse win (no other branch) ⇒ cat survival certified
tests.scenario: C0 --a(chance)--> {CW1, CW2} both terminal cat win

tests.name: cat has ONE action denying all mouse replies and all chance ⇒ survival, ∃ only over cat actions
tests.scenario: C0 {bad→M1 mouse win, good→M2}; M2 mouse replies x(chance{CX1,CX2}) and y→CY all survive
tests.note: cat may NOT choose the chance outcome; survival must hold for ALL outcomes of the mouse's reply

tests.name: every cat defense broken by an ADAPTIVE mouse strategy (not a fixed action string)
tests.witnessesDefect: F1 (adaptive ∃σ_m, policy is a map not a string)
tests.scenario: C0 {a→MA, b→MB}; MA needs p, MB needs q to win; no single fixed mouse action wins both

tests.name: node cap ⇒ UNRESOLVED, distinct from a genuine within-horizon non-win
tests.scenario: C0 cat OR with 6 actions; first 5 lose (mouse win), 6th survives; cap=4 truncates on 5th live node

tests.name: terminal MouseWins on the last mouse step is judged BEFORE the horizon cut
tests.scenario: C0 --a--> M1(mouse,idx1) --last--> CS(cat,idx2,terminal mouse via stranding); idx2>=2H but terminal
tests.note: horizon-first would wrongly return false; RULE-A cat-stranding MouseWins (mobility.ts:158-162) counts
